replies.body:
Images without texture pack, and during day please + lower FOV. It looks nice though, but I'm not really a fan of the gray part (the "kingdoms") nor the name however the grassy part is pretty nice; I recommend rotating the little huts better and making more structures in the map, and use that for your map template instead of the gray/wool place.
